audit.whatIsWrong: Two missing interactions from the brief were absent from the page: Galio can interrupt Bone Skewer's channel with Shield of Durand (W) or Hero's Entrance (R), and his combo opens with an auto-attack-reset (Colossal Smash, P) that telegraphs before the real threat lands. Also spikes[2].text says 'dodge his taunt line with your E' while attributing the taunt to E (Justice Punch) — the taunt is actually W (Shield of Durand); E is the knockup dash.
audit.why: Both missing interactions apply directly to this matchup per missingInteractions, and the taunt/E mislabel would send a reader to dodge the wrong ability with the wrong read.
audit.corrected: Folded the auto-reset tell into dosFull[1], the channel-punish warning into dontsFull[2], and fixed the taunt attribution in spikes[2].text.
